title: The CIA in Mexico? What a Surprise!
author: Polo Castellanos
content:
_This editorial by Polo Castellanos originally appeared in the[June 2, 2026
edition of ](https://rebelion.org/la-cia-en-mexico-que-
novedad/)_[Rebelión](https://rebelion.org/la-cia-en-mexico-que-novedad/) _.
The views expressed in this article are the authors’ own and do not
necessarily reflect those of  _Mexico Solidarity Media _  or the _Mexico
Solidarity Project _._

Under the name LITEMPO, one of the largest and most complex operations of the
Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) in Mexican territory began, consisting of a
whole network of paid agents and collaborators around the presidency of the
Republic since 1958 (J. Morley, 2011, _Our Man in Mexico: Winston Scott and
the Hidden History of the CIA_), as part of the psychological operations with
which the United States attacks our national sovereignty.

The first star agent, already active before Operation LITEMPO, was Adolfo
López Mateos, former president of Mexico, codename LITENSOR. And from the
operation's inception, with López Mateos's approval, came: Emilio Bolaños, a
car salesman and nephew of former president Gustavo Díaz Ordaz, codename
LITEMPO-1; Gustavo Díaz Ordaz, also responsible for the 1968 massacre,
codename LITEMPO-2; Fernando Gutiérrez Barrios, former governor of Veracruz
and Secretary of the Interior under Carlos Salinas de Gortari, codename
LITEMPO-4; Luis Echeverría Álvarez, former president of Mexico, codename
LITEMPO-8; and many other LITEMPOS, such as Miguel Nazar Haro, former director
of the now-defunct Federal Security Directorate and a prime example of state
terrorism. These are just some of the sinister characters who betrayed Mexico,
sold strategic information, were accomplices and puppets of the Monroe
Doctrine, lent themselves to the manipulations of the US government to achieve
its objectives, brutally repressed the Mexican people in their various
administrations, and for history were and are, although many of them are
underground, traitors to the homeland.

![](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/gustavo-diaz-
nixon.jpg)_President Gustavo Díaz Ordaz, responsible for the 1968 massacre,
CIA codename LITEMPO-2 with US President Richard Nixon._

Since then, the principles of non-intervention, self-determination, and
sovereignty in international law have been trampled on by the United States,
not only in Mexico but globally. Given this history, one would have to be
incredibly naive or foolish to believe that there aren't CIA agents in Mexico
conducting covert or overt operations as part of Psychological Warfare
Operations (PSWO) against our country. If the Iglesia de la Luz del Mundo
(Church of the Light of the World), in violation of the Constitution, has
ministers infiltrated in strategic positions within all three branches of
government and at all three levels, why would the CIA be any different? Of
course, for this to happen, the complicity or subservience of many actors
within the Mexican government is necessary.

Aside from US consulates and the US Embassy, ​​one of the CIA's perfect
fronts, and a hub for covert agents of various specialties, is the United
States Agency for International Development (USAID). This is nothing more than
US interventionist "diplomacy" for imperialism and fascism in the countries
where it operates, encompassing all strategic areas of these nations through
programs in health, education, the economy, security, human rights, youth,
women, agriculture, industry, and so on. For example, the human rights
advisors to former Secretary Alejandro Encinas at the Secretariat of the
Interior were USAID personnel in person—what a calamity! The world's most
violent terrorists lecturing on human rights! And with the blessing of the
Mexican government.

![](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/06/image-25.png)_Former Presidents Calderón (Mexico) &
George W. Bush (USA)_

Similarly, the "defunct" Iniciativa Mérida (Mérida Initiative) was nothing
more than a scheme of subordination and control over US police and
intelligence agencies like the DEA, the FBI, and of course the CIA, supposedly
for combating drug trafficking, organized crime, and "terrorism." Today, the
Mérida Initiative is grandiosely called the Bicentennial Understanding on
Security, Public Health, and Safe Communities. One of its components is the
"strengthening of police cooperation and bilateral information exchange…" (
[https://consulmex.sre.gob.mx/](https://consulmex.sre.gob.mx/orlando/index.php/avisos/114-entendimiento-
bi) ). In other words, the "Understanding" not only failed to limit the
functions of the interventionist Mérida Initiative but expanded them into the
areas of education, health, and society.

In the wake of the scandal surrounding the deaths of two of four CIA agents in
a supposed car accident after dismantling a drug lab in the Mexican state of
Chihuahua—a case involving national security and sovereignty—the voices of
official fanaticism leapt from their congressional stronghold to the murky
arena of shared responsibility, beating their chests in the name of the nation
they claim to defend. The target now is a far-right governor simply for being
governor, not because she can be directly implicated in any alleged crime,
even though she openly acknowledged being aware of the presence of foreign
agents operating on Mexican soil in the fight against organized crime,
something already established in the Bilateral Understanding.

For the ruling party and the parliamentary autocracy, someone has to take the
fall to cover up the true reality of violations of national sovereignty, the
presence of agents from the CIA, FBI, DEA, and whoever else is involved, and
the alleged complicity and responsibility of many of these individuals and
even institutions like the National Intelligence Center (CNI) itself. Who can
truly believe that the CNI is unaware of the CIA's undercover agents operating
in Mexico, plus those who infiltrate special operations and enter Mexico on
tourist, temporary worker, student, and other visas? And what role is the
Ministry of National Defense and the Second Section of Military Intelligence
playing in all of this? Is the President of the Republic aware of the
intricacies of intelligence and counterintelligence regarding national
security and sovereignty?

And the key question is how many traitors to the nation operate as CIA-paid
agents within state structures and in strategic positions—governments of the
32 states of the Republic, the Congress of the Union, the Judiciary, and the
Presidency. Or rather, how many new “LITEMPOS”—CIA agents—are currently
operating, subordinate to the United States, or governing while pretending to
defend our nation?
